$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

apiKey.description: Supermemory API key (can also use SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY env var)

similarityThreshold.description: Min similarity score for memory retrieval (0-1)

maxMemories.description: Max relevant memories injected per request

maxProjectMemories.description: Max project memories listed in context

maxProfileItems.description: Max profile facts injected in context

injectProfile.description: Include user profile in injected context

containerTagPrefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated container tags (used when userContainerTag/projectContainerTag are not set)

projectTagStrategy.description: Strategy for generating the project container tag when projectContainerTag is not set

anyOf.description: sha256 of the absolute checkout path. Tag changes if the directory moves.
sha256 of owner/repo parsed from the git remote (default). Stable across clones and machines.
owner_repo from the git remote, slashes replaced. Human-readable, path-safe.
Last segment of the absolute checkout path (the project directory name). No git lookup; falls back to hashDirectory if the path has no basename.

userContainerTag.description: Optional explicit user container tag (overrides auto-generated tag)

projectContainerTag.description: Optional explicit project container tag (overrides auto-generated tag)

filterPrompt.default: You are a stateful coding agent. Remember all the information, including but not limited to user's coding preferences, tech stack, behaviours, workflows, and any other relevant details.
filterPrompt.description: System prompt used as the memory-ingestion filter directive

keywordPatterns.description: Extra regex patterns for memory-trigger keyword detection

compactionThreshold.description: Context usage ratio that triggers preemptive compaction (0-1)

incrementalCapture.description: Save assistant turns progressively as they finish

maxCaptureChars.description: Maximum characters kept from any captured turn

sessionEndSave.description: Save a final memory snapshot when the session ends or idles

signalExtraction.description: Keep only turns that match signal keywords

signalKeywords.description: Keywords that mark a turn as high-signal and trigger capture

signalTurnsBefore.description: Number of earlier turns to include before a signal turn

recallKeywordPatterns.description: Extra phrases that trigger an explicit recall search

dedupEnabled.description: Skip duplicate memory saves by normalized content hash

dedupCacheSize.description: Maximum number of entries kept in the dedup cache

entityContext.default:
User-assistant conversation. Format: [role: user]...[user:end] and [role: assistant]...[assistant:end].

Only extract things useful in FUTURE conversations. Most messages are not worth remembering.

REMEMBER: lasting personal facts — dietary restrictions, preferences, personal details, workplace, location, tools, ongoing projects, routines, explicit "remember this" requests.

DO NOT REMEMBER: temporary intents, one-time tasks, assistant actions (searching, writing files, generating code), assistant suggestions, implementation details, in-progress task status.

RULES:
- Assistant output is CONTEXT ONLY — never attribute assistant actions to the user
- "find X" or "do Y" = one-time request, NOT a memory
- Only store preferences explicitly stated ("I like...", "I prefer...", "I always...")
- When in doubt, do NOT create a memory. Less is more.
entityContext.description: Short guidance passed to the entity-extraction pipeline

metadataStripping.description: Strip injected metadata from memory search queries

relativeTimeDisplay.description: Render memory timestamps as relative text (e.g. '2 hrs ago')

memoUsageFooter.description: Append a compact memory-count footer to injected context

profileCrossArrayDedup.description: Deduplicate profile facts across profile, project, and relevant-memory arrays

everyMessageRecall.description: Run recall search on every user message (costly; default off)

reinjectEveryN.description: Re-inject memory every N completed turns (0 disables it)

autoCategoryTagging.description: Classify memories into categories before storing them
